title: config-contract.yaml, Helm layer version 1
description: One chart's declaration of the configuration documents it renders and the images that read them, at charts/<chart>/config-contract.yaml. Normative prose is in DECLARATION.md, and every default is listed in DEFAULTS.md. Closed at every level: the file is written by hand in the chart repository, so a key nobody reads is a typo. terrace-contract enforces rules this schema cannot state (unique document names, unbound scopes naming declared documents, prerequisites outside the probed tree); its messages are authoritative.

documents.description: Every configuration document the chart renders. An empty list opts the chart out and requires `reason`.

reason.description: Why the chart declares no documents. Required when `documents` is empty.

bindings.description: Enrols the chart in the marker check: every contract key is bound to a chart value by a `@config` marker or written off in `unbound`. Default false.

tests.description: Enrols the chart in the generated round-trip suites. Every document then gets one; a document's own `tests` block only says how. Default false. Refused together with a contract-tests.yaml beside this file.

unconfigured.description: Values paths at which the chart pins an image that reads no contract-described configuration.

unbound.description: Contract keys the chart binds no chart value to, each group with a reason.

credentials.description: What the chart adds to the generated credential reference in its README, per contract key.

keys.description: Contract keys, written out one by one. There is no pattern form.

name.description: The document's name, unique in the chart. Every message names the document by it, and the default contract path is spelled from it.

images.description: The images that read the document. Default: the one image pinned at `image`, with its contract at `contracts/<name>.json`.

consumers.description: The workloads that mount the document, and their containers that read it. Default: inferred in each rendered values file from the workloads whose pod spec mounts the source object (ConfigMap or Secret sources only). An empty list checks no workload.

exempt.description: Rendered values files exempt from some gates, each with a reason.

restart.description: Keys the chart rolls its pods for although an image applies them live.

tests.description: How this document's round-trip suite is generated. Only on a chart with `tests: true`.

source.description: Which rendered object holds the document, and where inside it. Every field may be left out.

selector.description: The labels naming the object. Default `app.kubernetes.io/instance: <chart directory name>`, the release name the repository renders with.

key.description: The key under `data` holding the document. Default `config.toml`.

format.description: How the document is written. Default: from the key's extension (`.json`, `.yaml`/`.yml`), else `toml`.

values.description: The values path the chart pins the image at.

contract.description: The vendored contract, relative to the chart directory. May be left out only for a document's one image; default `contracts/<name>.json`.

values.description: The values file, or `*` for every one.

documents.description: The documents the write-off is scoped to. Default: every document that declares the key.

value.description: The chart value an operator may set instead of creating the Secret.

note.description: The condition under which this release needs the credential.

probe.description: The dotted values path every case writes into. Default `config`.

baseline.description: Scalar values every case carries, as dotted paths under `probe`.

reason.description: Why the baseline or probe path is needed. Required when either is set.

prerequisites.description: Chart values every case needs before the chart renders, outside the probed tree.

unrouted.description: Keys probed through the raw configuration tree instead of their chart value, each group with a reason.
